fields.summary_ko.0: TSMC (TSM) rose slightly to $405.87 on November 4, testing ability to achieve Q4 revenue target of $52.3B-$54.3B (midpoint $53.3B).
fields.summary_ko.1: Q4 target revenue represents 14.1% sequential growth versus Q3 approximately $46.7B, targeting gross margin of 65-67% and operating margin of 56.5-58.5%.
